summary: Implementation plan for integrating AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption (AEAD) with 96-bit SecureRandom nonces, 128-bit authentication tags, AAD context binding, Android Keystore 256-bit hardware-backed key management (with JVM test fallback), local guest storage encryption, Cloud Firestore PII field encryption, and an interactive AES-256-GCM Inspector in the Compliance & Security Hub.
